moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of summer.

angles.name: Bank Holiday Weekend Prep
angles.copy: That August Bank Holiday weekend feeling is almost here! What are your plans for the last long weekend of summer?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Just one more long weekend until September! Make the most of the August Bank Holiday – how are you celebrating the end of summer?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: Reading and Leeds Festivals take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 28-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Chase & Status, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. and RAYE.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Three days to go until Reading & Leeds kicks off! Who are you most excited to see this weekend? #RandL26

angles.name: Headliner Hype
angles.copy: The UK's biggest rock and pop party is almost here! Reading & Leeds brings Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine and more to the stage this Bank Holiday weekend. Get ready!

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 this week
moments.blurb: The massive dance festival Creamfields returns to Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-29, promising three days of electronic music.

angles.name: Creamfields Anticipation
angles.copy: Creamfields 2026 is just days away! Who's heading to Daresbury for the biggest dance party of the summer? #Creamfields

angles.name: Dance Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Get ready for the beats! Creamfields brings the biggest names in electronic music to Cheshire this weekend. What's your must-see set?

moments.title: All Points East Live Now

angles.name: London Festival Buzz
angles.copy: All Points East is ON in Victoria Park! If you're in London, what acts are you catching today or over the weekend? #APE2026

angles.name: Weekend Festival Fun
angles.copy: The vibes are high at All Points East! London's massive festival continues this weekend with a huge line-up. Hope you're enjoying it!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has secured a record-extending 22nd non-consecutive week at Number 1 on the UK Official Singles Chart, published August 21st.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 for an incredible 22nd week, smashing UK chart records. What a track!

angles.name: Longest Running No1
angles.copy: 22 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are rewriting the record books with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite Number 1 of all time?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing returns September 19
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is reportedly set to launch its 24th series on Saturday, September 19th, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Launch Date
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing reportedly launches on September 19th with a brand new presenting line-up. Who are you backing already?

angles.name: New Strictly Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are reportedly taking over as Strictly hosts this series! What do you think of the new trio?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns with new judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return in September with a new judge, Nigella Lawson, joining Paul Hollywood in the tent.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back

angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is reportedly joining Paul Hollywood as a judge on The Great British Bake Off! What do you think she'll bring to the tent?
